verdict.rationale: Appwrite's CLI (appwrite-cli) runs headlessly and can create/manage projects, resources, users, and functions via scriptable commands, and the docs mention JSON-based resource definitions (includes field) suitable for schema/config-as-code, which supports scripted backend provisioning. However, there is no direct evidence of a single documented workflow/example that stands up auth, database schema, and policies together in one script, and the hands-on probe shows the CLI works but doesn't demonstrate an end-to-end 'new backend' scaffold. missing for 10: an explicit documented or hands-on example of a full script provisioning schema+auth+policies end-to-end, evidence of policy/permission configuration via CLI, and confirmation the CLI supports idempotent bootstrapping of a brand-new project from scratch.
